description: Rank the vans on sale in the UK for a job, from THRIVE's van database, using the same rules as THRIVE's van spec builder: the job sets starting assumptions (van size, load, racking, extras, daily miles), and any argument given overrides them. Payload must cover the load plus THRIVE's racking and kit allowance; electric vans qualify only if 70% of official range covers the daily miles and there is somewhere to charge; a car licence covers 3,500kg, or 4,250kg electric. Returns the best version of up to five models with the reasons each fits, and the near misses with what rules them out.
